title: Higher education’s grade inflation conundrum
summary_en: Grade inflation is all the rage in higher education. Harvard has a proposal to reduce the number of A’s it awards. A Yale faculty committee proposed that 3.0 should be the mean grade.

title: Accreditation’s AI reckoning: Can colleges still prove students are learning?
summary_en: Higher education is approaching a credibility crisis: Colleges may still be awarding degrees, but can they prove that students—not their AI tools—have actually learned? Accreditation has long depended on evidence that institutions define outcomes, assess student achievement, and use results to improve.
title_cn: Accreditation’s AI reckoning: Can colleges still prove students are learning?
